verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents API products, webhooks, sandbox testing, an OpenAPI spec repo and an MCP server. None of it mentions API versioning schemes, version pinning, or a documented deprecation or sunset policy. Mentions of 'current API specifications' and a generated client library are adjacent and do not show versioned APIs with a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
